properties.source: Marine Regions IHO clipped to the official JWLA defined-water boundary
properties.sourceDocument: JWLA-033 (3 March 2026), unchanged in JWLA-034 (29 July 2026)
properties.geometryStatus: official-coordinate boundary clipped to IHO water bodies

properties.name: JWLA 033 - Venezuela (Offshore EEZ)
properties.sourceDocument: JWLA-033 (3 March 2026), unchanged in JWLA-034 (29 July 2026)
properties.officialRule: Venezuela, including all offshore installations in the Venezuelan EEZ; named-country defaults cover ports and coastal waters up to 12NM.
properties.warning: EEZ transit alone is not a definitive JWC entry event; installation-call evidence and manual review are required.

properties.name: JWLA 033 - Guyana (Offshore EEZ)
properties.sourceDocument: JWLA-033 (3 March 2026), unchanged in JWLA-034 (29 July 2026)
properties.officialRule: Guyana, but only calls to offshore installations in the Guyanese EEZ beyond territorial waters.
properties.warning: EEZ transit alone is not a definitive JWC entry event; installation-call evidence and manual review are required.
